description: This PHP class file defines the MaintenanceService class for the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It includes methods for managing purgeable entities, accessing employee data with specific access strategies, and interacting with the MaintenanceDao for database operations.

classes.name: MaintenanceService
classes.description: Service class handling maintenance operations such as retrieving purgeable entities and managing employee data access strategies.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Reads a YAML configuration file to retrieve a list of entities that can be purged.

methods.name: getAccessStrategy
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a specified access strategy class for data access control.

methods.name: accessEmployeeData
methods.description: Performs data access for an employee based on configured strategies, with transaction management and error handling.

methods.name: getMaintenanceDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MaintenanceDao instance for database interactions.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches data related to employee numbers from the database.
